Date: Restricted losses used against the sale of the assets bought again

Form 11 lines 810/811/818/819 (CG1 lines 10/11/18/19); crypto-assets go under "(k) Other Assets". Losses from earlier years (line 822 of your last return) are not subtracted here: they come off before the exemption. The exemption and losses are shared with your other assets' gains. The 4-week rule (s. 581) is applied as Revenue applies it (TDM 19-04-03). This report's own readings: day 28 counts as within 4 weeks; only purchases and exchanges count as buying again (not rewards or transfers); the figure due on 15 December counts a loss as restricted when the asset was bought again in December. A spouse's or civil partner's trades are not seen. Gains on foreign currency you hold (s. 532(b)) are not computed.
NOTE: Restricted losses used this year against the sale of the assets bought again:
Each is counted in this year's losses, up to the gain on the assets bought again.
